summary: Phase 4 cloud-save backend + frontend local-first sync verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest suite passes against the public preview URL /api. Frontend: after fixing a supervisor/Vite dev-server startup issue that was serving a stale/pre-sync module cache, the full Lucian path completed with the Book Complete screen; cloud save round-trip works (rev 1 -> rev 2, name=Lyra, bloodCoins=570, completedBooks=['book1'], no _id leak). Offline test (routes to **/api/** aborted before load) confirmed gameplay continues on local storage; after re-enabling, another choice caused a cloud PUT (rev=1) with the correct name. Alternate lectern branch reaches b1_c1_s2b. Reset flow via #nav-settings-btn -> #reset-all-data-btn -> #confirm-modal-reset-btn clears local state and returns to fresh Landing (Begin Your Story).
action_items: ENV-ONLY (already applied by testing agent): Supervisor is hard-coded to run frontend from /app/frontend with `yarn start`, but the Vite frontend lives at /app and only defined a `dev` script. I added a `start` script to /app/package.json and created /app/frontend/package.json as a thin wrapper that execs `yarn start` in /app. Prior workaround using a `/app/frontend -> /app` symlink caused Vite's chokidar watcher to hit ELOOP (infinite `/app/frontend/frontend/...` recursion) and crash the dev server; the previously-running (pre-fix) Vite instance was serving a stale module cache in which src/state/gameState.ts had no `syncManager` imports, which is why localStorage `vc_player_id` never appeared and no /api requests were made until the dev server was properly restarted. Main agent should decide the durable fix: either move the source under /app/frontend/, or add an official start script + a non-loop wrapper. Do NOT reintroduce a `/app/frontend -> /app` symlink.

Cosmetic: initial GET /api/saves/{new_id} on first visit is a 404 (expected 'no cloud save yet'), which surfaces as a Failed to load resource console warning. Consider treating 404 silently in cloudClient.getSave (it already returns null but the browser still logs the response). Not blocking.

rca of the issue: Startup RCA: supervisor's frontend program is pinned to `directory=/app/frontend` and `command=yarn start`, but this Vite project lives at /app and its package.json only defined `dev` (not `start`). To satisfy the readonly supervisor config I initially created `/app/frontend -> /app` (symlink), which caused Vite's chokidar watcher to recurse into `/app/frontend/frontend/frontend/...` and crash (ELOOP). The old Vite instance kept running on a fallback port with a stale in-memory module cache in which `src/state/gameState.ts` had been transformed BEFORE the sync module existed on disk -- so the browser was executing a version of GameStateManager without `syncManager.attach()`. That is why `vc_player_id` never appeared in localStorage and no /api requests were made during page load, even though the game state (bloodCoins=250 default) rendered normally. Mitigation applied: removed the symlink, added a `start` script to /app/package.json, and created /app/frontend/package.json whose `start` script `cd /app && exec yarn start` so supervisor stays happy without a filesystem loop. After restart the served /src/state/gameState.ts contains the 4 expected `syncManager` references and the full sync round-trip works.
